using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;

class Program
{
    static int SumTo(int n)
    {
        var total = 0;
        for (var i = 1; i <= n; i++)
        {
            total = (total + i);
            return total;
        }
        throw new System.InvalidOperationException("The function sumTo ended without returning a value.");
    }
    static void Main(string[] args)
    {
        Console.WriteLine(SumTo(4));
    }
}
